sansScript: The back office needs JavaScript. Turn it on, then reload the page.

demo.texte: Demo: changes stay in this browser and publishing is simulated.

connexion.intro: Sign in to edit the portfolio content.
connexion.nonAdmin: This account cannot access the back office.
connexion.reseau: Unable to sign in right now. Check your connection and try again.

tableau.aucune: Nothing published yet: the site shows the original content.
tableau.traductionsTexte: {nombre} field(s) have no English version yet. The English site then shows the French text, marked as such.
tableau.traductionsCompletes: Every text has its English version.

statuts.remplacee: Replaced by a more recent publication

sections.intro: The order of this list is the order of the sections on the home page. The numbers shown on the site are recalculated.

projets.intro: The order of this list is the order on the site. Numbers, counter and project count are recalculated.
projets.confirmerSuppression: Delete “{nom}”? The project will disappear from the site at the next publication.

editeur.aideEnrichi: Wrap a passage in two asterisks (**like this**) to highlight it.
editeur.aideIdentifiant: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. It forms the address of the project page.
editeur.aideIdentifiantCategorie: Stable technical identifier used to attach projects to this category.
editeur.aideMotif: {numero} is replaced by the image number.

medias.aideImage: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 50 MB max. The image is optimised when publishing.
medias.envoye: File uploaded. It will appear on the site after publishing.
medias.typeRefuse: This file type is not accepted here.
medias.tropLourd: The file is larger than 50 MB.
medias.intro: {nombre} files shown on the site. Each link opens the screen where the file is replaced.

apercu.cadre: Preview of the site with the current changes

messages.conflit: This content was changed from another device. Reload the page to get the latest version before continuing.
messages.erreurEnregistrement: Saving failed. Your changes are still here: try again.
messages.invalide: Cannot publish: fix these points first.
messages.publie: Publication no. {version} started. The site will be updated in a few minutes.
messages.erreurPublication: Publishing could not start. Try again in a moment.
messages.chargementImpossible: The content could not be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.
messages.amorce: Initial content taken from the current site. Save to import it into the back office.
